title: The Forest Repeats
text: A damaged traveler journal records: Whispering currents retain short phrases for years, but the roots change their meaning by altering the pauses.

title: Lanternvine Courtesy
text: An old field report states: Fae lights dim when approached directly and brighten when travelers politely pretend not to notice them.

title: Rootway Agreement
text: A local record preserves this account: Ancient residents marked safe paths by braiding three living vines without cutting any stem.

title: Pollen Moon
text: An unsigned observation reads: Silver spores rise once each cycle and cause nearby flowers to imitate whatever constellation hangs overhead.

title: Please Stop Teaching the Vines
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki wrote: "They learned to open buckles. I accept some responsibility and none of the blame."

title: Search Team Marker
text: An old field report states: A metal tag beneath the moss identifies a pursuit unit assigned to recover escaped experimental subjects.

title: The Listening Grove
text: A local record preserves this account: Travelers avoided speaking names here because the forest whispered them back in unfamiliar voices.

title: Dreamsap Warning
text: An unsigned observation reads: Fresh dreamsap closes wounds, while old dreamsap preserves the last nightmare of anything that touched it.

title: Shrine Beneath the Roots
text: A damaged traveler journal records: A Fae altar predates the surrounding forest; the oldest roots curve around it without crossing its shadow.

title: An Excellent Hiding Place
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki annotated a search map: "They checked this grove six times. I was in the map cabinet."

title: Moonmoth Migration
text: A local record preserves this account: Moonmoths navigate by reflected starlight even where the canopy has hidden the surface for centuries.

title: Briar Treaty
text: An unsigned observation reads: A carved tablet grants one grove the right to defend itself against axes, fire, and rude singing.

title: The Borrowed Voice
text: A damaged traveler journal records: One vine repeats a researcher's command phrase, but records identify that researcher as dead for eighty years.

title: Greenwater Apothecary
text: An old field report states: Forest healers collected remedies only from plants that voluntarily released a leaf when thanked.

title: Definitely a Normal Bush
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: A doodled sign reads: "No escaped elf behind this shrub. Please direct search teams elsewhere. --Not Shizuki"

title: Pursuit Ledger Fragment
text: An unsigned observation reads: The teams tracked unusual Fae signatures from Moonlit Reef into the forest, then lost the trail among thousands of false echoes.

title: Memory in the Bark
text: A damaged traveler journal records: A cut root grew rings around a metal restraint and eventually crushed it into harmless flakes.

title: Whispercap Consensus
text: An old field report states: A colony of whispercaps repeats warnings by majority vote, making urgent messages take several hours.

title: Grovekeeper's Law
text: A local record preserves this account: Visitors may harvest fallen pods, but taking a living bloom without permission forfeits the thief's sense of direction.

title: Searchlight Spores
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki's note says: "Their detection spores make you glow. Rolling in blue pollen makes you glow differently. Problem solved."

title: The Unseen Shrine
text: A damaged traveler journal records: A shrine becomes visible only in reflections and disappears whenever anyone attempts to measure it.

title: Rootbound Effigy
text: An old field report states: The effigy contains no bones or machinery, only compacted letters from travelers who asked the forest for guidance.

title: Team Twelve's Last Report
text: A local record preserves this account: A pursuit captain reported that the target could not be distinguished from the forest's own Fae magic.

title: The Moving Boundary
text: An unsigned observation reads: Survey stones migrate several paces each night while the trees insist, through whispers, that they have not moved.

title: Returned Access Card
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: Shizuki returned an old card decades later with flowers painted over the authorization stripe.

title: Glimmerpod Nursery
text: An old field report states: Glimmerpods open around patient visitors and snap shut near active facility weapons.

title: The Search Continued
text: A local record preserves this account: Successor records show the organization renewed its escaped-subject search under new personnel and inherited ranks.

title: Forest Countermeasure
text: An unsigned observation reads: Roots learned to mimic pursuit signals, sending search constructs in circles until their power failed.

title: No Recapture Record
text: A damaged traveler journal records: Every surviving ledger lists Subject Seven as outstanding; none records a successful recovery.

title: The Forest Keeps Secrets
text: A page in Shizuki's familiar handwriting says: The final root archive closes around names connected to the rebellion, preserving them without revealing their fate.
